title: Edge AI Inference & Digital Twins
description: Embedded deep learning inference, model quantization (INT8), local analytics, and real-time digital twin state sync.

questions.question: What is a 'Digital Twin' in modern Industrial IoT (IIoT)?
options: A real-time virtual digital representation of a physical asset or industrial process
A backup USB drive kept in the factory office safe
Two identical microcontrollers soldered to the same circuit board
An automated bot account operating on social media

questions.question: Why is model quantization (e.g., FP32 to INT8) essential for edge device inference?
options: Reduces memory footprint and computational latency to run on low-power accelerators
Converts neural network weights into human-readable JSON files
Enables wireless charging through radio frequency harvesting
Prevents edge microcontrollers from requiring an operating system

questions.question: Which edge hardware accelerator is commonly used for high-efficiency neural network inference at the edge?
options: NPU (Neural Processing Unit) / Edge TPU
Rotational Magnetic Tape Drive
Standard Audio Sound Card
Parallel Printer Port

questions.question: What is 'Fog Computing' in relation to edge and cloud topologies?
options: A decentralized computing layer situated between edge IoT devices and centralized cloud data centers
Running servers in refrigerated climate-controlled containers
Streaming data only during stormy or overcast weather conditions
Encrypting packets using random pseudo-noise headers

questions.question: What hardware component secures cryptographic keys and roots of trust on edge IoT hardware?
options: TPM (Trusted Platform Module) / Secure Element
MicroSD Flash Card
Capacitive Touchscreen Controller
Linear Voltage Regulator
